summary: Executed backend + frontend verification for the urgent auth/maps/access-code scope. Live map-health now shows 'Google Maps connected' with real gm-style/canvas rendering. Forgot-password sends Supabase recovery with redirect_to=/auth/callback?recovery=1 and shows success message. Frontend unit suites (18/18), production build, and backend pytest (4/4) pass. Reset password and developer access-code behavioral checks are validated by existing deterministic tests (MOCKED where intentionally isolated).

integration_issues.issue: Direct navigation to /auth/callback?recovery=1 without a valid Supabase recovery session/token did not transition to /reset-password in automation; this is expected for tokenless callback, so full live redirect still needs one real recovery-link click validation.

action_items: Run one manual real recovery-email link click (with valid token) to conclusively confirm callback -> /reset-password navigation in live browser session.
If available, run one authenticated developer JWT RPC check to re-confirm EXECUTE=true for authenticated in live env (anon deny already verified).
critical_code_review_comments: RPC permission model in migration is correctly hardened: EXECUTE revoked from anon/public and granted to authenticated for mahaflow_create_access_code.
Auth callback routing intentionally depends on a real recovered session before redirecting to /reset-password; tokenless callback URL alone is insufficient.
test_credentials: Used documented test identity from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (skynetxofficial@gmail.com). No developer interactive credentials were available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated map-health real rendering and forgot-password recovery request wiring against public preview URL. Anon RPC call to Supabase function returns permission denied (expected). Remaining unclosed point is live callback redirect with a real recovery token/session.
rca of the issue: Observed non-redirect on /auth/callback?recovery=1 when opened directly without token. Root cause: useAuthSession redirects only after Supabase provides a real session (PASSWORD_RECOVERY/SIGNED_IN flow). Mitigation: validate using actual recovery email link containing token fragments, not bare callback URL.
